purpose: Bounded public artifact intake for later idea-level reconciliation and section classification. Existing source owners remain authoritative for their stated evidence.

scope.reads: Path names only; no idea extraction or document-content acceptance claims.
scope.visibility: rg-visible files respecting ignore rules; ignored private novels are not enumerated.
scope.selection: Markdown and JSON artifacts with audit, report, packets, findings, small_touches, proposals, reconciliation, coverage, review, validation or intake in their basename, plus the explicit related_research_detail whitelist.
scope.excluded: Private novels; sealed/raw/history/reader/captured/source-trace directories; scripts and non-documents; DIGEST_ source summaries and named capture/request indexes. Excluded counts concern rg-visible files only.
scope.other_project_owners: Only the three requested prior owners are linked here; docs/worlds, docs/gm wave backlogs and other project audits are not covered by the research scan.

next_processing_contract.each_distinct_idea: Assign a stable idea ID linked to exact source sections and its existing owner; preserve detailed subideas and conflicting variants.
next_processing_contract.public_secret_handling: Do not copy sealed truths into this public inventory. Later sealed coverage may reference opaque IDs, routes and verification status.
next_processing_contract.completion_claim: Inventory inclusion supplies no gameplay, fidelity, persistence, browser or director acceptance evidence.
